'''FC Iskra Rîbnița''' is a [[Moldova]]n [[football (soccer)|football]] club with its legal address in [[Păpăuți, Rezina|Păpăuți]].<ref>{{#invoke:cite|news|title=Asociația Obștească Fotbal Club "ISKRA"|url=https://data2b.md/ro/companies/1022620006326/fotbal-club-iskra/|access-date=24 August 2026|publisher=data2b.md}}</ref>The team currently competes in [[Moldovan Liga 1|Liga 1]], the second tier of Moldovan football, and plays its home matches at the Real Succes Stadium in [[Chișinău]]."}}
